sloka: तम् देशम् अहम् आगम्य दीन सत्त्वः सुदुर्मनाः ।अपश्यम् इषुणा तीरे सरय्वाः तापसम् हतम् ॥२-६३-३८॥
transliteration: tam deśam aham āgamya dīna sattvaḥ sudurmanāḥ ।apaśyam iṣuṇā tīre sarayvāḥ tāpasam hatam ॥2-63-38॥

translations.english: With dissipated energy and intensely troubled mind, I reached the bank of river Sarayu and there I saw the ascetic lying struck by the arrow and with scattered locks of hair. The water pitcher was thrown away and his body smeared with blood and dust as he lay on the ground.
